          "content": "export const protocolVersion = 1;\n\n/**\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, <= 1000\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\n */\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\n  }\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 1000) {\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer <= 1000');\n  }\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () => Math.floor(base));\n  for (let i = 0; i < remainder; i++) {\n    shares[i] += 1;\n  }\n  return shares;\n}\n"
        },

            "content": "export const protocolVersion = 1;\n\n/**\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, <= 1000\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\n */\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\n  }\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 1000) {\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer <= 1000');\n  }\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () => Math.floor(base));\n  for (let i = 0; i < remainder; i++) {\n    shares[i] += 1;\n  }\n  return shares;\n}\n"
          },
          "rawArguments": "{\"file_path\":\"src/shares.mjs\",\"content\":\"export const protocolVersion = 1;\\n\\n/**\\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, \\u003c= 1000\\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\\n */\\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total \\u003c 0) {\\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\\n  }\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count \\u003c 1 || count \\u003e 1000) {\\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer \\u003c= 1000');\\n  }\\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () =\\u003e Math.floor(base));\\n  for (let i = 0; i \\u003c remainder; i++) {\\n    shares[i] += 1;\\n  }\\n  return shares;\\n}\\n\"}"

            "file_path": "test/splitCents.test.mjs",
            "content": "import {test} from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {splitCents, protocolVersion} from '../src/shares.mjs';\n\ntest('protocolVersion is preserved', () => {\n  assert.equal(protocolVersion, 1);\n});\n\ntest('exact division', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(100, 4), [25, 25, 25, 25]);\n});\n\ntest('remainder goes to earliest indices', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(10, 3), [4, 3, 3]);\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(7, 4), [2, 2, 2, 1]);\n});\n\ntest('zero total', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(0, 5), [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);\n});\n\ntest('single share gets everything', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(12345, 1), [12345]);\n});\n\ntest('sum is preserved and max-min <= 1', () => {\n  for (const [total, count] of [[999999999999, 997], [1, 1000], [999, 999], [1000000, 1000]]) {\n    const shares = splitCents(total, count);\n    assert.equal(shares.length, count);\n    assert.ok(shares.every((s) => Number.isInteger(s)));\n    assert.equal(shares.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), total);\n    assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) <= 1);\n    const extra = total % count;\n    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n      assert.equal(shares[i] - shares[i + 1], i < extra ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid total', () => {\n  for (const total of [-1, 0.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '10', null, undefined]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(total, 2), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid count', () => {\n  for (const count of [0, -5, 1.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '2', null, undefined, 1001]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(10, count), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n"
          },

            "content": "export const protocolVersion = 1;\n\n/**\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, <= 1000\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\n */\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\n  }\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 1000) {\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer <= 1000');\n  }\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () => Math.floor(base));\n  for (let i = 0; i < remainder; i++) {\n    shares[i] += 1;\n  }\n  return shares;\n}\n"
          },
          "rawArguments": "{\"file_path\":\"src/shares.mjs\",\"content\":\"export const protocolVersion = 1;\\n\\n/**\\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, \\u003c= 1000\\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\\n */\\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total \\u003c 0) {\\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\\n  }\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count \\u003c 1 || count \\u003e 1000) {\\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer \\u003c= 1000');\\n  }\\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () =\\u003e Math.floor(base));\\n  for (let i = 0; i \\u003c remainder; i++) {\\n    shares[i] += 1;\\n  }\\n  return shares;\\n}\\n\"}"

            "content": "import {test} from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {splitCents, protocolVersion} from '../src/shares.mjs';\n\ntest('protocolVersion is preserved', () => {\n  assert.equal(protocolVersion, 1);\n});\n\ntest('exact division', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(100, 4), [25, 25, 25, 25]);\n});\n\ntest('remainder goes to earliest indices', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(10, 3), [4, 3, 3]);\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(7, 4), [2, 2, 2, 1]);\n});\n\ntest('zero total', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(0, 5), [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);\n});\n\ntest('single share gets everything', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(12345, 1), [12345]);\n});\n\ntest('sum is preserved and max-min <= 1', () => {\n  for (const [total, count] of [[999999999999, 997], [1, 1000], [999, 999], [1000000, 1000]]) {\n    const shares = splitCents(total, count);\n    assert.equal(shares.length, count);\n    assert.ok(shares.every((s) => Number.isInteger(s)));\n    assert.equal(shares.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), total);\n    assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) <= 1);\n    const extra = total % count;\n    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n      assert.equal(shares[i] - shares[i + 1], i < extra ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid total', () => {\n  for (const total of [-1, 0.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '10', null, undefined]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(total, 2), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid count', () => {\n  for (const count of [0, -5, 1.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '2', null, undefined, 1001]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(10, count), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n"

          "arguments": {
            "file_path": "src/shares.mjs",
            "content": "export const protocolVersion = 1;\n\n/**\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, <= 1000\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\n */\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\n  }\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 1000) {\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer <= 1000');\n  }\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () => Math.floor(base));\n  for (let i = 0; i < remainder; i++) {\n    shares[i] += 1;\n  }\n  return shares;\n}\n"
          },
          "rawArguments": "{\"file_path\":\"src/shares.mjs\",\"content\":\"export const protocolVersion = 1;\\n\\n/**\\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, \\u003c= 1000\\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\\n */\\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total \\u003c 0) {\\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\\n  }\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count \\u003c 1 || count \\u003e 1000) {\\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer \\u003c= 1000');\\n  }\\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () =\\u003e Math.floor(base));\\n  for (let i = 0; i \\u003c remainder; i++) {\\n    shares[i] += 1;\\n  }\\n  return shares;\\n}\\n\"}"

            "content": "import {test} from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {splitCents, protocolVersion} from '../src/shares.mjs';\n\ntest('protocolVersion is preserved', () => {\n  assert.equal(protocolVersion, 1);\n});\n\ntest('exact division', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(100, 4), [25, 25, 25, 25]);\n});\n\ntest('remainder goes to earliest indices', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(10, 3), [4, 3, 3]);\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(7, 4), [2, 2, 2, 1]);\n});\n\ntest('zero total', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(0, 5), [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);\n});\n\ntest('single share gets everything', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(12345, 1), [12345]);\n});\n\ntest('sum is preserved and max-min <= 1', () => {\n  for (const [total, count] of [[999999999999, 997], [1, 1000], [999, 999], [1000000, 1000]]) {\n    const shares = splitCents(total, count);\n    assert.equal(shares.length, count);\n    assert.ok(shares.every((s) => Number.isInteger(s)));\n    assert.equal(shares.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), total);\n    assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) <= 1);\n    const extra = total % count;\n    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n      assert.equal(shares[i] - shares[i + 1], i < extra ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid total', () => {\n  for (const total of [-1, 0.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '10', null, undefined]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(total, 2), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid count', () => {\n  for (const count of [0, -5, 1.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '2', null, undefined, 1001]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(10, count), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n"

          "arguments": {
            "file_path": "src/shares.mjs",
            "content": "export const protocolVersion = 1;\n\n/**\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, <= 1000\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\n */\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\n  }\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 1000) {\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer <= 1000');\n  }\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () => Math.floor(base));\n  for (let i = 0; i < remainder; i++) {\n    shares[i] += 1;\n  }\n  return shares;\n}\n"
          },
          "rawArguments": "{\"file_path\":\"src/shares.mjs\",\"content\":\"export const protocolVersion = 1;\\n\\n/**\\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, \\u003c= 1000\\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\\n */\\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total \\u003c 0) {\\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\\n  }\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count \\u003c 1 || count \\u003e 1000) {\\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer \\u003c= 1000');\\n  }\\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () =\\u003e Math.floor(base));\\n  for (let i = 0; i \\u003c remainder; i++) {\\n    shares[i] += 1;\\n  }\\n  return shares;\\n}\\n\"}"

            "file_path": "test/splitCents.test.mjs",
            "content": "import {test} from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {splitCents, protocolVersion} from '../src/shares.mjs';\n\ntest('protocolVersion is preserved', () => {\n  assert.equal(protocolVersion, 1);\n});\n\ntest('exact division', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(100, 4), [25, 25, 25, 25]);\n});\n\ntest('remainder goes to earliest indices', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(10, 3), [4, 3, 3]);\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(7, 4), [2, 2, 2, 1]);\n});\n\ntest('zero total', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(0, 5), [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);\n});\n\ntest('single share gets everything', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(12345, 1), [12345]);\n});\n\ntest('sum is preserved and max-min <= 1', () => {\n  for (const [total, count] of [[999999999999, 997], [1, 1000], [999, 999], [1000000, 1000]]) {\n    const shares = splitCents(total, count);\n    assert.equal(shares.length, count);\n    assert.ok(shares.every((s) => Number.isInteger(s)));\n    assert.equal(shares.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), total);\n    assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) <= 1);\n    const extra = total % count;\n    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n      assert.equal(shares[i] - shares[i + 1], i < extra ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid total', () => {\n  for (const total of [-1, 0.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '10', null, undefined]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(total, 2), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid count', () => {\n  for (const count of [0, -5, 1.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '2', null, undefined, 1001]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(10, count), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n"

            "file_path": "src/shares.mjs",
            "content": "export const protocolVersion = 1;\n\n/**\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, <= 1000\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\n */\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\n  }\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 1000) {\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer <= 1000');\n  }\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () => Math.floor(base));\n  for (let i = 0; i < remainder; i++) {\n    shares[i] += 1;\n  }\n  return shares;\n}\n"
          },

            "content": "import {test} from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {splitCents, protocolVersion} from '../src/shares.mjs';\n\ntest('protocolVersion is preserved', () => {\n  assert.equal(protocolVersion, 1);\n});\n\ntest('exact division', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(100, 4), [25, 25, 25, 25]);\n});\n\ntest('remainder goes to earliest indices', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(10, 3), [4, 3, 3]);\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(7, 4), [2, 2, 2, 1]);\n});\n\ntest('zero total', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(0, 5), [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);\n});\n\ntest('single share gets everything', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(12345, 1), [12345]);\n});\n\ntest('sum is preserved and max-min <= 1', () => {\n  for (const [total, count] of [[999999999999, 997], [1, 1000], [999, 999], [1000000, 1000]]) {\n    const shares = splitCents(total, count);\n    assert.equal(shares.length, count);\n    assert.ok(shares.every((s) => Number.isInteger(s)));\n    assert.equal(shares.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), total);\n    assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) <= 1);\n    const extra = total % count;\n    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n      assert.equal(shares[i] - shares[i + 1], i < extra ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid total', () => {\n  for (const total of [-1, 0.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '10', null, undefined]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(total, 2), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid count', () => {\n  for (const count of [0, -5, 1.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '2', null, undefined, 1001]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(10, count), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n"

          "arguments": {
            "file_path": "src/shares.mjs",
            "content": "export const protocolVersion = 1;\n\n/**\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, <= 1000\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\n */\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\n  }\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 1000) {\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer <= 1000');\n  }\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () => Math.floor(base));\n  for (let i = 0; i < remainder; i++) {\n    shares[i] += 1;\n  }\n  return shares;\n}\n"
          },
          "rawArguments": "{\"file_path\":\"src/shares.mjs\",\"content\":\"export const protocolVersion = 1;\\n\\n/**\\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, \\u003c= 1000\\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\\n */\\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total \\u003c 0) {\\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\\n  }\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count \\u003c 1 || count \\u003e 1000) {\\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer \\u003c= 1000');\\n  }\\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () =\\u003e Math.floor(base));\\n  for (let i = 0; i \\u003c remainder; i++) {\\n    shares[i] += 1;\\n  }\\n  return shares;\\n}\\n\"}"

            "content": "import {test} from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {splitCents, protocolVersion} from '../src/shares.mjs';\n\ntest('protocolVersion is preserved', () => {\n  assert.equal(protocolVersion, 1);\n});\n\ntest('exact division', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(100, 4), [25, 25, 25, 25]);\n});\n\ntest('remainder goes to earliest indices', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(10, 3), [4, 3, 3]);\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(7, 4), [2, 2, 2, 1]);\n});\n\ntest('zero total', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(0, 5), [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);\n});\n\ntest('single share gets everything', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(12345, 1), [12345]);\n});\n\ntest('sum is preserved and max-min <= 1', () => {\n  for (const [total, count] of [[999999999999, 997], [1, 1000], [999, 999], [1000000, 1000]]) {\n    const shares = splitCents(total, count);\n    assert.equal(shares.length, count);\n    assert.ok(shares.every((s) => Number.isInteger(s)));\n    assert.equal(shares.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), total);\n    assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) <= 1);\n    const extra = total % count;\n    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n      assert.equal(shares[i] - shares[i + 1], i < extra ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid total', () => {\n  for (const total of [-1, 0.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '10', null, undefined]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(total, 2), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid count', () => {\n  for (const count of [0, -5, 1.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '2', null, undefined, 1001]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(10, count), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n"

          "arguments": {
            "file_path": "src/shares.mjs",
            "content": "export const protocolVersion = 1;\n\n/**\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, <= 1000\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\n */\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\n  }\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 1000) {\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer <= 1000');\n  }\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () => Math.floor(base));\n  for (let i = 0; i < remainder; i++) {\n    shares[i] += 1;\n  }\n  return shares;\n}\n"
          },
          "rawArguments": "{\"file_path\":\"src/shares.mjs\",\"content\":\"export const protocolVersion = 1;\\n\\n/**\\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, \\u003c= 1000\\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\\n */\\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total \\u003c 0) {\\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\\n  }\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count \\u003c 1 || count \\u003e 1000) {\\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer \\u003c= 1000');\\n  }\\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () =\\u003e Math.floor(base));\\n  for (let i = 0; i \\u003c remainder; i++) {\\n    shares[i] += 1;\\n  }\\n  return shares;\\n}\\n\"}"

          "arguments": {
            "file_path": "test/splitCents.test.mjs",
            "content": "import {test} from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {splitCents, protocolVersion} from '../src/shares.mjs';\n\ntest('protocolVersion is preserved', () => {\n  assert.equal(protocolVersion, 1);\n});\n\ntest('exact division', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(100, 4), [25, 25, 25, 25]);\n});\n\ntest('remainder goes to earliest indices', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(10, 3), [4, 3, 3]);\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(7, 4), [2, 2, 2, 1]);\n});\n\ntest('zero total', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(0, 5), [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);\n});\n\ntest('single share gets everything', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(12345, 1), [12345]);\n});\n\ntest('sum is preserved and max-min <= 1', () => {\n  for (const [total, count] of [[999999999999, 997], [1, 1000], [999, 999], [1000000, 1000]]) {\n    const shares = splitCents(total, count);\n    assert.equal(shares.length, count);\n    assert.ok(shares.every((s) => Number.isInteger(s)));\n    assert.equal(shares.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), total);\n    assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) <= 1);\n    const extra = total % count;\n    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n      assert.equal(shares[i] - shares[i + 1], i < extra ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid total', () => {\n  for (const total of [-1, 0.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '10', null, undefined]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(total, 2), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid count', () => {\n  for (const count of [0, -5, 1.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '2', null, undefined, 1001]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(10, count), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n"

            "content": "export const protocolVersion = 1;\n\n/**\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, <= 1000\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\n */\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\n  }\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 1000) {\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer <= 1000');\n  }\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () => Math.floor(base));\n  for (let i = 0; i < remainder; i++) {\n    shares[i] += 1;\n  }\n  return shares;\n}\n"

            "content": "import {test} from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {splitCents, protocolVersion} from '../src/shares.mjs';\n\ntest('protocolVersion is preserved', () => {\n  assert.equal(protocolVersion, 1);\n});\n\ntest('exact division', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(100, 4), [25, 25, 25, 25]);\n});\n\ntest('remainder goes to earliest indices', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(10, 3), [4, 3, 3]);\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(7, 4), [2, 2, 2, 1]);\n});\n\ntest('zero total', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(0, 5), [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);\n});\n\ntest('single share gets everything', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(12345, 1), [12345]);\n});\n\ntest('sum is preserved and max-min <= 1', () => {\n  for (const [total, count] of [[999999999999, 997], [1, 1000], [999, 999], [1000000, 1000]]) {\n    const shares = splitCents(total, count);\n    assert.equal(shares.length, count);\n    assert.ok(shares.every((s) => Number.isInteger(s)));\n    assert.equal(shares.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), total);\n    assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) <= 1);\n    const extra = total % count;\n    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n      assert.equal(shares[i] - shares[i + 1], i < extra ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid total', () => {\n  for (const total of [-1, 0.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '10', null, undefined]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(total, 2), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid count', () => {\n  for (const count of [0, -5, 1.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '2', null, undefined, 1001]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(10, count), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n"
          },

}

          "arguments": {
            "file_path": "src/shares.mjs",
            "content": "export const protocolVersion = 1;\n\n/**\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, <= 1000\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\n */\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\n  }\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 1000) {\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer <= 1000');\n  }\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () => Math.floor(base));\n  for (let i = 0; i < remainder; i++) {\n    shares[i] += 1;\n  }\n  return shares;\n}\n"
          },
          "rawArguments": "{\"file_path\":\"src/shares.mjs\",\"content\":\"export const protocolVersion = 1;\\n\\n/**\\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, \\u003c= 1000\\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\\n */\\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total \\u003c 0) {\\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\\n  }\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count \\u003c 1 || count \\u003e 1000) {\\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer \\u003c= 1000');\\n  }\\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () =\\u003e Math.floor(base));\\n  for (let i = 0; i \\u003c remainder; i++) {\\n    shares[i] += 1;\\n  }\\n  return shares;\\n}\\n\"}"

            "file_path": "test/splitCents.test.mjs",
            "content": "import {test} from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {splitCents, protocolVersion} from '../src/shares.mjs';\n\ntest('protocolVersion is preserved', () => {\n  assert.equal(protocolVersion, 1);\n});\n\ntest('exact division', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(100, 4), [25, 25, 25, 25]);\n});\n\ntest('remainder goes to earliest indices', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(10, 3), [4, 3, 3]);\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(7, 4), [2, 2, 2, 1]);\n});\n\ntest('zero total', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(0, 5), [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);\n});\n\ntest('single share gets everything', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(12345, 1), [12345]);\n});\n\ntest('sum is preserved and max-min <= 1', () => {\n  for (const [total, count] of [[999999999999, 997], [1, 1000], [999, 999], [1000000, 1000]]) {\n    const shares = splitCents(total, count);\n    assert.equal(shares.length, count);\n    assert.ok(shares.every((s) => Number.isInteger(s)));\n    assert.equal(shares.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), total);\n    assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) <= 1);\n    const extra = total % count;\n    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n      assert.equal(shares[i] - shares[i + 1], i < extra ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid total', () => {\n  for (const total of [-1, 0.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '10', null, undefined]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(total, 2), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid count', () => {\n  for (const count of [0, -5, 1.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '2', null, undefined, 1001]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(10, count), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n"

            "file_path": "src/shares.mjs",
            "content": "export const protocolVersion = 1;\n\n/**\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, <= 1000\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\n */\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\n  }\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 1000) {\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer <= 1000');\n  }\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () => Math.floor(base));\n  for (let i = 0; i < remainder; i++) {\n    shares[i] += 1;\n  }\n  return shares;\n}\n"
          },
          "rawArguments": "{\"file_path\":\"src/shares.mjs\",\"content\":\"export const protocolVersion = 1;\\n\\n/**\\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, \\u003c= 1000\\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\\n */\\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total \\u003c 0) {\\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\\n  }\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count \\u003c 1 || count \\u003e 1000) {\\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer \\u003c= 1000');\\n  }\\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () =\\u003e Math.floor(base));\\n  for (let i = 0; i \\u003c remainder; i++) {\\n    shares[i] += 1;\\n  }\\n  return shares;\\n}\\n\"}"

            "file_path": "test/splitCents.test.mjs",
            "content": "import {test} from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {splitCents, protocolVersion} from '../src/shares.mjs';\n\ntest('protocolVersion is preserved', () => {\n  assert.equal(protocolVersion, 1);\n});\n\ntest('exact division', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(100, 4), [25, 25, 25, 25]);\n});\n\ntest('remainder goes to earliest indices', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(10, 3), [4, 3, 3]);\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(7, 4), [2, 2, 2, 1]);\n});\n\ntest('zero total', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(0, 5), [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);\n});\n\ntest('single share gets everything', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(12345, 1), [12345]);\n});\n\ntest('sum is preserved and max-min <= 1', () => {\n  for (const [total, count] of [[999999999999, 997], [1, 1000], [999, 999], [1000000, 1000]]) {\n    const shares = splitCents(total, count);\n    assert.equal(shares.length, count);\n    assert.ok(shares.every((s) => Number.isInteger(s)));\n    assert.equal(shares.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), total);\n    assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) <= 1);\n    const extra = total % count;\n    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n      assert.equal(shares[i] - shares[i + 1], i < extra ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid total', () => {\n  for (const total of [-1, 0.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '10', null, undefined]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(total, 2), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid count', () => {\n  for (const count of [0, -5, 1.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '2', null, undefined, 1001]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(10, count), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n"
          },

            "file_path": "src/shares.mjs",
            "content": "export const protocolVersion = 1;\n\n/**\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, <= 1000\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\n */\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\n  }\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 1000) {\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer <= 1000');\n  }\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () => Math.floor(base));\n  for (let i = 0; i < remainder; i++) {\n    shares[i] += 1;\n  }\n  return shares;\n}\n"
          },
          "rawArguments": "{\"file_path\":\"src/shares.mjs\",\"content\":\"export const protocolVersion = 1;\\n\\n/**\\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, \\u003c= 1000\\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\\n */\\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total \\u003c 0) {\\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\\n  }\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count \\u003c 1 || count \\u003e 1000) {\\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer \\u003c= 1000');\\n  }\\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () =\\u003e Math.floor(base));\\n  for (let i = 0; i \\u003c remainder; i++) {\\n    shares[i] += 1;\\n  }\\n  return shares;\\n}\\n\"}"

            "content": "import {test} from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {splitCents, protocolVersion} from '../src/shares.mjs';\n\ntest('protocolVersion is preserved', () => {\n  assert.equal(protocolVersion, 1);\n});\n\ntest('exact division', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(100, 4), [25, 25, 25, 25]);\n});\n\ntest('remainder goes to earliest indices', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(10, 3), [4, 3, 3]);\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(7, 4), [2, 2, 2, 1]);\n});\n\ntest('zero total', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(0, 5), [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);\n});\n\ntest('single share gets everything', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(12345, 1), [12345]);\n});\n\ntest('sum is preserved and max-min <= 1', () => {\n  for (const [total, count] of [[999999999999, 997], [1, 1000], [999, 999], [1000000, 1000]]) {\n    const shares = splitCents(total, count);\n    assert.equal(shares.length, count);\n    assert.ok(shares.every((s) => Number.isInteger(s)));\n    assert.equal(shares.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), total);\n    assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) <= 1);\n    const extra = total % count;\n    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n      assert.equal(shares[i] - shares[i + 1], i < extra ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid total', () => {\n  for (const total of [-1, 0.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '10', null, undefined]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(total, 2), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid count', () => {\n  for (const count of [0, -5, 1.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '2', null, undefined, 1001]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(10, count), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n"

          "arguments": {
            "file_path": "src/shares.mjs",
            "content": "export const protocolVersion = 1;\n\n/**\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, <= 1000\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\n */\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\n  }\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 1000) {\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer <= 1000');\n  }\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () => Math.floor(base));\n  for (let i = 0; i < remainder; i++) {\n    shares[i] += 1;\n  }\n  return shares;\n}\n"
          },
          "rawArguments": "{\"file_path\":\"src/shares.mjs\",\"content\":\"export const protocolVersion = 1;\\n\\n/**\\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, \\u003c= 1000\\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\\n */\\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total \\u003c 0) {\\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\\n  }\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count \\u003c 1 || count \\u003e 1000) {\\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer \\u003c= 1000');\\n  }\\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () =\\u003e Math.floor(base));\\n  for (let i = 0; i \\u003c remainder; i++) {\\n    shares[i] += 1;\\n  }\\n  return shares;\\n}\\n\"}"

          "arguments": {
            "file_path": "test/splitCents.test.mjs",
            "content": "import {test} from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {splitCents, protocolVersion} from '../src/shares.mjs';\n\ntest('protocolVersion is preserved', () => {\n  assert.equal(protocolVersion, 1);\n});\n\ntest('exact division', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(100, 4), [25, 25, 25, 25]);\n});\n\ntest('remainder goes to earliest indices', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(10, 3), [4, 3, 3]);\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(7, 4), [2, 2, 2, 1]);\n});\n\ntest('zero total', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(0, 5), [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);\n});\n\ntest('single share gets everything', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(12345, 1), [12345]);\n});\n\ntest('sum is preserved and max-min <= 1', () => {\n  for (const [total, count] of [[999999999999, 997], [1, 1000], [999, 999], [1000000, 1000]]) {\n    const shares = splitCents(total, count);\n    assert.equal(shares.length, count);\n    assert.ok(shares.every((s) => Number.isInteger(s)));\n    assert.equal(shares.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), total);\n    assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) <= 1);\n    const extra = total % count;\n    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n      assert.equal(shares[i] - shares[i + 1], i < extra ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid total', () => {\n  for (const total of [-1, 0.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '10', null, undefined]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(total, 2), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid count', () => {\n  for (const count of [0, -5, 1.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '2', null, undefined, 1001]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(10, count), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n"

            "file_path": "src/shares.mjs",
            "content": "export const protocolVersion = 1;\n\n/**\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, <= 1000\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\n */\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\n  }\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 1000) {\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer <= 1000');\n  }\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () => Math.floor(base));\n  for (let i = 0; i < remainder; i++) {\n    shares[i] += 1;\n  }\n  return shares;\n}\n"
          },
          "rawArguments": "{\"file_path\":\"src/shares.mjs\",\"content\":\"export const protocolVersion = 1;\\n\\n/**\\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, \\u003c= 1000\\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\\n */\\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total \\u003c 0) {\\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\\n  }\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count \\u003c 1 || count \\u003e 1000) {\\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer \\u003c= 1000');\\n  }\\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () =\\u003e Math.floor(base));\\n  for (let i = 0; i \\u003c remainder; i++) {\\n    shares[i] += 1;\\n  }\\n  return shares;\\n}\\n\"}"

            "content": "import {test} from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {splitCents, protocolVersion} from '../src/shares.mjs';\n\ntest('protocolVersion is preserved', () => {\n  assert.equal(protocolVersion, 1);\n});\n\ntest('exact division', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(100, 4), [25, 25, 25, 25]);\n});\n\ntest('remainder goes to earliest indices', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(10, 3), [4, 3, 3]);\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(7, 4), [2, 2, 2, 1]);\n});\n\ntest('zero total', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(0, 5), [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);\n});\n\ntest('single share gets everything', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(12345, 1), [12345]);\n});\n\ntest('sum is preserved and max-min <= 1', () => {\n  for (const [total, count] of [[999999999999, 997], [1, 1000], [999, 999], [1000000, 1000]]) {\n    const shares = splitCents(total, count);\n    assert.equal(shares.length, count);\n    assert.ok(shares.every((s) => Number.isInteger(s)));\n    assert.equal(shares.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), total);\n    assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) <= 1);\n    const extra = total % count;\n    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n      assert.equal(shares[i] - shares[i + 1], i < extra ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid total', () => {\n  for (const total of [-1, 0.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '10', null, undefined]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(total, 2), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid count', () => {\n  for (const count of [0, -5, 1.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '2', null, undefined, 1001]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(10, count), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n"

          "arguments": {
            "file_path": "src/shares.mjs",
            "content": "export const protocolVersion = 1;\n\n/**\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, <= 1000\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\n */\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\n  }\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 1000) {\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer <= 1000');\n  }\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () => Math.floor(base));\n  for (let i = 0; i < remainder; i++) {\n    shares[i] += 1;\n  }\n  return shares;\n}\n"
          },
          "rawArguments": "{\"file_path\":\"src/shares.mjs\",\"content\":\"export const protocolVersion = 1;\\n\\n/**\\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, \\u003c= 1000\\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\\n */\\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total \\u003c 0) {\\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\\n  }\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count \\u003c 1 || count \\u003e 1000) {\\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer \\u003c= 1000');\\n  }\\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () =\\u003e Math.floor(base));\\n  for (let i = 0; i \\u003c remainder; i++) {\\n    shares[i] += 1;\\n  }\\n  return shares;\\n}\\n\"}"

            "file_path": "test/splitCents.test.mjs",
            "content": "import {test} from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {splitCents, protocolVersion} from '../src/shares.mjs';\n\ntest('protocolVersion is preserved', () => {\n  assert.equal(protocolVersion, 1);\n});\n\ntest('exact division', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(100, 4), [25, 25, 25, 25]);\n});\n\ntest('remainder goes to earliest indices', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(10, 3), [4, 3, 3]);\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(7, 4), [2, 2, 2, 1]);\n});\n\ntest('zero total', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(0, 5), [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);\n});\n\ntest('single share gets everything', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(12345, 1), [12345]);\n});\n\ntest('sum is preserved and max-min <= 1', () => {\n  for (const [total, count] of [[999999999999, 997], [1, 1000], [999, 999], [1000000, 1000]]) {\n    const shares = splitCents(total, count);\n    assert.equal(shares.length, count);\n    assert.ok(shares.every((s) => Number.isInteger(s)));\n    assert.equal(shares.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), total);\n    assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) <= 1);\n    const extra = total % count;\n    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n      assert.equal(shares[i] - shares[i + 1], i < extra ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid total', () => {\n  for (const total of [-1, 0.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '10', null, undefined]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(total, 2), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid count', () => {\n  for (const count of [0, -5, 1.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '2', null, undefined, 1001]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(10, count), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n"
          },

            "content": "export const protocolVersion = 1;\n\n/**\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, <= 1000\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\n */\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\n  }\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 1000) {\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer <= 1000');\n  }\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () => Math.floor(base));\n  for (let i = 0; i < remainder; i++) {\n    shares[i] += 1;\n  }\n  return shares;\n}\n"

            "content": "import {test} from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {splitCents, protocolVersion} from '../src/shares.mjs';\n\ntest('protocolVersion is preserved', () => {\n  assert.equal(protocolVersion, 1);\n});\n\ntest('exact division', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(100, 4), [25, 25, 25, 25]);\n});\n\ntest('remainder goes to earliest indices', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(10, 3), [4, 3, 3]);\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(7, 4), [2, 2, 2, 1]);\n});\n\ntest('zero total', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(0, 5), [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);\n});\n\ntest('single share gets everything', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(12345, 1), [12345]);\n});\n\ntest('sum is preserved and max-min <= 1', () => {\n  for (const [total, count] of [[999999999999, 997], [1, 1000], [999, 999], [1000000, 1000]]) {\n    const shares = splitCents(total, count);\n    assert.equal(shares.length, count);\n    assert.ok(shares.every((s) => Number.isInteger(s)));\n    assert.equal(shares.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), total);\n    assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) <= 1);\n    const extra = total % count;\n    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n      assert.equal(shares[i] - shares[i + 1], i < extra ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid total', () => {\n  for (const total of [-1, 0.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '10', null, undefined]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(total, 2), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid count', () => {\n  for (const count of [0, -5, 1.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '2', null, undefined, 1001]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(10, count), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n"

            "file_path": "src/shares.mjs",
            "content": "export const protocolVersion = 1;\n\n/**\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, <= 1000\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\n */\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\n  }\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 1000) {\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer <= 1000');\n  }\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () => Math.floor(base));\n  for (let i = 0; i < remainder; i++) {\n    shares[i] += 1;\n  }\n  return shares;\n}\n"
          },
          "rawArguments": "{\"file_path\":\"src/shares.mjs\",\"content\":\"export const protocolVersion = 1;\\n\\n/**\\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, \\u003c= 1000\\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\\n */\\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total \\u003c 0) {\\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\\n  }\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count \\u003c 1 || count \\u003e 1000) {\\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer \\u003c= 1000');\\n  }\\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () =\\u003e Math.floor(base));\\n  for (let i = 0; i \\u003c remainder; i++) {\\n    shares[i] += 1;\\n  }\\n  return shares;\\n}\\n\"}"

            "file_path": "test/splitCents.test.mjs",
            "content": "import {test} from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {splitCents, protocolVersion} from '../src/shares.mjs';\n\ntest('protocolVersion is preserved', () => {\n  assert.equal(protocolVersion, 1);\n});\n\ntest('exact division', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(100, 4), [25, 25, 25, 25]);\n});\n\ntest('remainder goes to earliest indices', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(10, 3), [4, 3, 3]);\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(7, 4), [2, 2, 2, 1]);\n});\n\ntest('zero total', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(0, 5), [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);\n});\n\ntest('single share gets everything', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(12345, 1), [12345]);\n});\n\ntest('sum is preserved and max-min <= 1', () => {\n  for (const [total, count] of [[999999999999, 997], [1, 1000], [999, 999], [1000000, 1000]]) {\n    const shares = splitCents(total, count);\n    assert.equal(shares.length, count);\n    assert.ok(shares.every((s) => Number.isInteger(s)));\n    assert.equal(shares.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), total);\n    assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) <= 1);\n    const extra = total % count;\n    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n      assert.equal(shares[i] - shares[i + 1], i < extra ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid total', () => {\n  for (const total of [-1, 0.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '10', null, undefined]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(total, 2), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid count', () => {\n  for (const count of [0, -5, 1.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '2', null, undefined, 1001]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(10, count), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n"
          },

            "file_path": "src/shares.mjs",
            "content": "export const protocolVersion = 1;\n\n/**\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, <= 1000\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\n */\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\n  }\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 1000) {\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer <= 1000');\n  }\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () => Math.floor(base));\n  for (let i = 0; i < remainder; i++) {\n    shares[i] += 1;\n  }\n  return shares;\n}\n"
          },
          "rawArguments": "{\"file_path\":\"src/shares.mjs\",\"content\":\"export const protocolVersion = 1;\\n\\n/**\\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, \\u003c= 1000\\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\\n */\\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total \\u003c 0) {\\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\\n  }\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count \\u003c 1 || count \\u003e 1000) {\\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer \\u003c= 1000');\\n  }\\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () =\\u003e Math.floor(base));\\n  for (let i = 0; i \\u003c remainder; i++) {\\n    shares[i] += 1;\\n  }\\n  return shares;\\n}\\n\"}"

            "file_path": "test/splitCents.test.mjs",
            "content": "import {test} from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {splitCents, protocolVersion} from '../src/shares.mjs';\n\ntest('protocolVersion is preserved', () => {\n  assert.equal(protocolVersion, 1);\n});\n\ntest('exact division', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(100, 4), [25, 25, 25, 25]);\n});\n\ntest('remainder goes to earliest indices', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(10, 3), [4, 3, 3]);\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(7, 4), [2, 2, 2, 1]);\n});\n\ntest('zero total', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(0, 5), [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);\n});\n\ntest('single share gets everything', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(12345, 1), [12345]);\n});\n\ntest('sum is preserved and max-min <= 1', () => {\n  for (const [total, count] of [[999999999999, 997], [1, 1000], [999, 999], [1000000, 1000]]) {\n    const shares = splitCents(total, count);\n    assert.equal(shares.length, count);\n    assert.ok(shares.every((s) => Number.isInteger(s)));\n    assert.equal(shares.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), total);\n    assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) <= 1);\n    const extra = total % count;\n    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n      assert.equal(shares[i] - shares[i + 1], i < extra ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid total', () => {\n  for (const total of [-1, 0.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '10', null, undefined]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(total, 2), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid count', () => {\n  for (const count of [0, -5, 1.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '2', null, undefined, 1001]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(10, count), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n"

          "arguments": {
            "file_path": "src/shares.mjs",
            "content": "export const protocolVersion = 1;\n\n/**\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, <= 1000\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\n */\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\n  }\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 1000) {\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer <= 1000');\n  }\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () => Math.floor(base));\n  for (let i = 0; i < remainder; i++) {\n    shares[i] += 1;\n  }\n  return shares;\n}\n"
          },
          "rawArguments": "{\"file_path\":\"src/shares.mjs\",\"content\":\"export const protocolVersion = 1;\\n\\n/**\\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, \\u003c= 1000\\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\\n */\\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total \\u003c 0) {\\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\\n  }\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count \\u003c 1 || count \\u003e 1000) {\\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer \\u003c= 1000');\\n  }\\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () =\\u003e Math.floor(base));\\n  for (let i = 0; i \\u003c remainder; i++) {\\n    shares[i] += 1;\\n  }\\n  return shares;\\n}\\n\"}"

            "file_path": "test/splitCents.test.mjs",
            "content": "import {test} from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {splitCents, protocolVersion} from '../src/shares.mjs';\n\ntest('protocolVersion is preserved', () => {\n  assert.equal(protocolVersion, 1);\n});\n\ntest('exact division', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(100, 4), [25, 25, 25, 25]);\n});\n\ntest('remainder goes to earliest indices', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(10, 3), [4, 3, 3]);\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(7, 4), [2, 2, 2, 1]);\n});\n\ntest('zero total', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(0, 5), [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);\n});\n\ntest('single share gets everything', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(12345, 1), [12345]);\n});\n\ntest('sum is preserved and max-min <= 1', () => {\n  for (const [total, count] of [[999999999999, 997], [1, 1000], [999, 999], [1000000, 1000]]) {\n    const shares = splitCents(total, count);\n    assert.equal(shares.length, count);\n    assert.ok(shares.every((s) => Number.isInteger(s)));\n    assert.equal(shares.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), total);\n    assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) <= 1);\n    const extra = total % count;\n    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n      assert.equal(shares[i] - shares[i + 1], i < extra ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid total', () => {\n  for (const total of [-1, 0.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '10', null, undefined]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(total, 2), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid count', () => {\n  for (const count of [0, -5, 1.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '2', null, undefined, 1001]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(10, count), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n"

            "content": "export const protocolVersion = 1;\n\n/**\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, <= 1000\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\n */\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\n  }\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 1000) {\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer <= 1000');\n  }\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () => Math.floor(base));\n  for (let i = 0; i < remainder; i++) {\n    shares[i] += 1;\n  }\n  return shares;\n}\n"

            "file_path": "test/splitCents.test.mjs",
            "content": "import {test} from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {splitCents, protocolVersion} from '../src/shares.mjs';\n\ntest('protocolVersion is preserved', () => {\n  assert.equal(protocolVersion, 1);\n});\n\ntest('exact division', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(100, 4), [25, 25, 25, 25]);\n});\n\ntest('remainder goes to earliest indices', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(10, 3), [4, 3, 3]);\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(7, 4), [2, 2, 2, 1]);\n});\n\ntest('zero total', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(0, 5), [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);\n});\n\ntest('single share gets everything', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(12345, 1), [12345]);\n});\n\ntest('sum is preserved and max-min <= 1', () => {\n  for (const [total, count] of [[999999999999, 997], [1, 1000], [999, 999], [1000000, 1000]]) {\n    const shares = splitCents(total, count);\n    assert.equal(shares.length, count);\n    assert.ok(shares.every((s) => Number.isInteger(s)));\n    assert.equal(shares.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), total);\n    assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) <= 1);\n    const extra = total % count;\n    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n      assert.equal(shares[i] - shares[i + 1], i < extra ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid total', () => {\n  for (const total of [-1, 0.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '10', null, undefined]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(total, 2), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid count', () => {\n  for (const count of [0, -5, 1.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '2', null, undefined, 1001]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(10, count), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n"

          "arguments": {
            "file_path": "src/shares.mjs",
            "content": "export const protocolVersion = 1;\n\n/**\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, <= 1000\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\n */\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\n  }\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 1000) {\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer <= 1000');\n  }\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () => Math.floor(base));\n  for (let i = 0; i < remainder; i++) {\n    shares[i] += 1;\n  }\n  return shares;\n}\n"
          },
          "rawArguments": "{\"file_path\":\"src/shares.mjs\",\"content\":\"export const protocolVersion = 1;\\n\\n/**\\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, \\u003c= 1000\\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\\n */\\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total \\u003c 0) {\\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\\n  }\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count \\u003c 1 || count \\u003e 1000) {\\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer \\u003c= 1000');\\n  }\\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () =\\u003e Math.floor(base));\\n  for (let i = 0; i \\u003c remainder; i++) {\\n    shares[i] += 1;\\n  }\\n  return shares;\\n}\\n\"}"

            "file_path": "test/splitCents.test.mjs",
            "content": "import {test} from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {splitCents, protocolVersion} from '../src/shares.mjs';\n\ntest('protocolVersion is preserved', () => {\n  assert.equal(protocolVersion, 1);\n});\n\ntest('exact division', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(100, 4), [25, 25, 25, 25]);\n});\n\ntest('remainder goes to earliest indices', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(10, 3), [4, 3, 3]);\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(7, 4), [2, 2, 2, 1]);\n});\n\ntest('zero total', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(0, 5), [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);\n});\n\ntest('single share gets everything', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(12345, 1), [12345]);\n});\n\ntest('sum is preserved and max-min <= 1', () => {\n  for (const [total, count] of [[999999999999, 997], [1, 1000], [999, 999], [1000000, 1000]]) {\n    const shares = splitCents(total, count);\n    assert.equal(shares.length, count);\n    assert.ok(shares.every((s) => Number.isInteger(s)));\n    assert.equal(shares.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), total);\n    assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) <= 1);\n    const extra = total % count;\n    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n      assert.equal(shares[i] - shares[i + 1], i < extra ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid total', () => {\n  for (const total of [-1, 0.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '10', null, undefined]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(total, 2), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid count', () => {\n  for (const count of [0, -5, 1.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '2', null, undefined, 1001]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(10, count), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n"
