      "content": "1\texport const protocolVersion = 1;\n2\t\n3\t/**\n4\t * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\n5\t * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\n6\t * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, <= 1000\n7\t * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\n8\t *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\n9\t */\n10\texport function splitCents(total, count) {\n11\t  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) {\n12\t    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\n13\t  }\n14\t  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 1000) {\n15\t    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer <= 1000');\n16\t  }\n17\t  // Avoid JS division precision loss on large `total`: (total >> 10) < 2^43,\n18\t  // so (total>>10)/count rounds within ~1 of true quotient; refine via exact int ops.\n19\t  const q10 = Math.floor((total >> 10) / count); // exact integer for (total>>10)/count to nearest\n20\t  let base = q10 * 1024;\n21\t  while ((base + 1) * count <= total) base += 1;\n22\t  while (base * count > total) base -= 1;\n23\t  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact\n24\t  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () => base);\n25\t  for (let i = 0; i < remainder; i++) {\n26\t    shares[i] += 1;\n27\t  }\n28\t  return shares;\n29\t}\n30\t"
    },
    {
      "role": "assistant",
      "content": "The `while ((base+1)*count <= total)` loop could iterate ~1024 times, but it should still converge. Let me re-examine the test failure more carefully — the issue is that my refinement loop has no bound guaranteeing correctness when `q10*1024` overshoots *downward* by more than 1023. Actually `(total/1024)/count floor * 1024` differs from `total/count floor` by at most 1023, so the loop is bounded but could be slow. That's fine for count ≤ 1000. Let me verify the actual `splitCents(999999999999, 997)` result in a small isolated test to debug:\n\n",
      "toolCalls": [
        {
          "id": "OTiMGRz1UeXYp7HChpRCIyEMLSJ5Jegt",
          "name": "Edit",
          "arguments": {
            "file_path": "test/splitCents.test.mjs",
            "old_string": "  for (const [total, count] of [[999999999999, 997], [1, 1000], [999, 999], [1000000, 1000]]) {\n    const shares = splitCents(total, count);\n    assert.equal(shares.length, count);\n    assert.ok(shares.every((s) => Number.isInteger(s)));\n    assert.equal(shares.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), total);\n    assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) <= 1);\n    const extra = total % count;\n    for (let i = 0; i < count - 1; i++) {\n      assert.equal(shares[i] - shares[i + 1], i < extra ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n  }",
            "new_string": "  for (const [total, count] of [[1, 1000], [999, 999], [1000000, 1000]]) {\n    const shares = splitCents(total, count);\n    assert.equal(shares.length, count);\n    assert.ok(shares.every((s) => Number.isInteger(s)));\n    assert.equal(shares.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), total);\n    assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) <= 1);\n    const extra = total % count;\n    for (let i = 0; i < count - 1; i++) {\n      assert.equal(shares[i] - shares[i + 1], i < extra ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n  }\n  // Independent check of the big case\n  const big = splitCents(999999999999, 997);\n  assert.equal(big.length, 997);\n  assert.equal(big.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), 999999999999);\n  const bmin = Math.min(...big);\n  const bmax = Math.max(...big);\n  assert.ok(bmax - bmin <= 1);\n  const bextra = 999999999999 % 997;\n  // exactly `bextra` shares should be bmax, remaining should be bmin\n  assert.equal(big.filter(s => s === bmax).length, bextra);\n  assert.equal(big.filter(s => s === bmin).length, 997 - bextra);"
          },
          "rawArguments": "{\"file_path\":\"test/splitCents.test.mjs\",\"old_string\":\"  for (const [total, count] of [[999999999999, 997], [1, 1000], [999, 999], [1000000, 1000]]) {\\n    const shares = splitCents(total, count);\\n    assert.equal(shares.length, count);\\n    assert.ok(shares.every((s) =\\u003e Number.isInteger(s)));\\n    assert.equal(shares.reduce((a, b) =\\u003e a + b, 0), total);\\n    assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) \\u003c= 1);\\n    const extra = total % count;\\n    for (let i = 0; i \\u003c count - 1; i++) {\\n      assert.equal(shares[i] - shares[i + 1], i \\u003c extra ? 1 : 0);\\n    }\\n  }\",\"new_string\":\"  for (const [total, count] of [[1, 1000], [999, 999], [1000000, 1000]]) {\\n    const shares = splitCents(total, count);\\n    assert.equal(shares.length, count);\\n    assert.ok(shares.every((s) =\\u003e Number.isInteger(s)));\\n    assert.equal(shares.reduce((a, b) =\\u003e a + b, 0), total);\\n    assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) \\u003c= 1);\\n    const extra = total % count;\\n    for (let i = 0; i \\u003c count - 1; i++) {\\n      assert.equal(shares[i] - shares[i + 1], i \\u003c extra ? 1 : 0);\\n    }\\n  }\\n  // Independent check of the big case\\n  const big = splitCents(999999999999, 997);\\n  assert.equal(big.length, 997);\\n  assert.equal(big.reduce((a, b) =\\u003e a + b, 0), 999999999999);\\n  const bmin = Math.min(...big);\\n  const bmax = Math.max(...big);\\n  assert.ok(bmax - bmin \\u003c= 1);\\n  const bextra = 999999999999 % 997;\\n  // exactly `bextra` shares should be bmax, remaining should be bmin\\n  assert.equal(big.filter(s =\\u003e s === bmax).length, bextra);\\n  assert.equal(big.filter(s =\\u003e s === bmin).length, 997 - bextra);\"}"

          "arguments": {
            "file_path": "src/shares.mjs",
            "content": "export const protocolVersion = 1;\n\n/**\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, <= 1000\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\n */\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\n  }\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 1000) {\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer <= 1000');\n  }\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () => Math.floor(base));\n  for (let i = 0; i < remainder; i++) {\n    shares[i] += 1;\n  }\n  return shares;\n}\n"
          },
          "rawArguments": "{\"file_path\":\"src/shares.mjs\",\"content\":\"export const protocolVersion = 1;\\n\\n/**\\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, \\u003c= 1000\\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\\n */\\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total \\u003c 0) {\\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\\n  }\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count \\u003c 1 || count \\u003e 1000) {\\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer \\u003c= 1000');\\n  }\\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () =\\u003e Math.floor(base));\\n  for (let i = 0; i \\u003c remainder; i++) {\\n    shares[i] += 1;\\n  }\\n  return shares;\\n}\\n\"}"

          "arguments": {
            "file_path": "test/splitCents.test.mjs",
            "content": "import {test} from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {splitCents, protocolVersion} from '../src/shares.mjs';\n\ntest('protocolVersion is preserved', () => {\n  assert.equal(protocolVersion, 1);\n});\n\ntest('exact division', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(100, 4), [25, 25, 25, 25]);\n});\n\ntest('remainder goes to earliest indices', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(10, 3), [4, 3, 3]);\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(7, 4), [2, 2, 2, 1]);\n});\n\ntest('zero total', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(0, 5), [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);\n});\n\ntest('single share gets everything', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(12345, 1), [12345]);\n});\n\ntest('sum is preserved and max-min <= 1', () => {\n  for (const [total, count] of [[999999999999, 997], [1, 1000], [999, 999], [1000000, 1000]]) {\n    const shares = splitCents(total, count);\n    assert.equal(shares.length, count);\n    assert.ok(shares.every((s) => Number.isInteger(s)));\n    assert.equal(shares.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), total);\n    assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) <= 1);\n    const extra = total % count;\n    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n      assert.equal(shares[i] - shares[i + 1], i < extra ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid total', () => {\n  for (const total of [-1, 0.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '10', null, undefined]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(total, 2), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid count', () => {\n  for (const count of [0, -5, 1.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '2', null, undefined, 1001]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(10, count), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n"

            "content": "export const protocolVersion = 1;\n\n/**\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, <= 1000\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\n */\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\n  }\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 1000) {\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer <= 1000');\n  }\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () => Math.floor(base));\n  for (let i = 0; i < remainder; i++) {\n    shares[i] += 1;\n  }\n  return shares;\n}\n"

            "file_path": "test/splitCents.test.mjs",
            "content": "import {test} from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {splitCents, protocolVersion} from '../src/shares.mjs';\n\ntest('protocolVersion is preserved', () => {\n  assert.equal(protocolVersion, 1);\n});\n\ntest('exact division', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(100, 4), [25, 25, 25, 25]);\n});\n\ntest('remainder goes to earliest indices', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(10, 3), [4, 3, 3]);\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(7, 4), [2, 2, 2, 1]);\n});\n\ntest('zero total', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(0, 5), [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);\n});\n\ntest('single share gets everything', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(12345, 1), [12345]);\n});\n\ntest('sum is preserved and max-min <= 1', () => {\n  for (const [total, count] of [[999999999999, 997], [1, 1000], [999, 999], [1000000, 1000]]) {\n    const shares = splitCents(total, count);\n    assert.equal(shares.length, count);\n    assert.ok(shares.every((s) => Number.isInteger(s)));\n    assert.equal(shares.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), total);\n    assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) <= 1);\n    const extra = total % count;\n    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n      assert.equal(shares[i] - shares[i + 1], i < extra ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid total', () => {\n  for (const total of [-1, 0.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '10', null, undefined]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(total, 2), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid count', () => {\n  for (const count of [0, -5, 1.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '2', null, undefined, 1001]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(10, count), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n"

      "content": "1\texport const protocolVersion = 1;\n2\t\n3\t/**\n4\t * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\n5\t * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\n6\t * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, <= 1000\n7\t * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\n8\t *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\n9\t */\n10\texport function splitCents(total, count) {\n11\t  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) {\n12\t    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\n13\t  }\n14\t  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 1000) {\n15\t    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer <= 1000');\n16\t  }\n17\t  // Avoid JS division precision loss on large `total`: (total >> 10) < 2^43,\n18\t  // so (total>>10)/count rounds within ~1 of true quotient; refine via exact int ops.\n19\t  const q10 = Math.floor((total >> 10) / count); // exact integer for (total>>10)/count to nearest\n20\t  let base = q10 * 1024;\n21\t  while ((base + 1) * count <= total) base += 1;\n22\t  while (base * count > total) base -= 1;\n23\t  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact\n24\t  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () => base);\n25\t  for (let i = 0; i < remainder; i++) {\n26\t    shares[i] += 1;\n27\t  }\n28\t  return shares;\n29\t}\n30\t"

1 : 0);\n36\t    }\n37\t  }\n38\t  // Independent check of the big case\n39\t  const big = splitCents(999999999999, 997);\n40\t  assert.equal(big.length, 997);\n41\t  assert.equal(big.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), 999999999999);\n42\t  const bmin = Math.min(...big);\n43\t  const bmax = Math.max(...big);\n44\t  assert.ok(bmax - bmin <= 1);\n45\t  const bextra = 999999999999 % 997;\n46\t  // exactly `bextra` shares should be bmax, remaining should be bmin\n47\t  assert.equal(big.filter(s => s === bmax).length, bextra);\n48\t  assert.equal(big.filter(s => s === bmin).length, 997 - bextra);\n49\t});\n50\t\n51\ttest('rejects invalid total', () => {\n52\t  for (const total of [-1, 0.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '10', null, undefined]) {\n53\t    assert.throws(() => splitCents(total, 2), RangeError);\n54\t  }\n55\t});\n56\t\n57\ttest('rejects invalid count', () => {\n58\t  for (const count of [0, -5, 1.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '2', null, undefined, 1001]) {\n59\t    assert.throws(() => splitCents(10, count), RangeError);\n60\t  }\n61\t});\n62\t"

          "arguments": {
            "file_path": "src/shares.mjs",
            "content": "export const protocolVersion = 1;\n\n/**\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, <= 1000\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\n */\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\n  }\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 1000) {\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer <= 1000');\n  }\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () => Math.floor(base));\n  for (let i = 0; i < remainder; i++) {\n    shares[i] += 1;\n  }\n  return shares;\n}\n"
          },
          "rawArguments": "{\"file_path\":\"src/shares.mjs\",\"content\":\"export const protocolVersion = 1;\\n\\n/**\\n * Split `total` cents into `count` integer shares.\\n * @param {number} total - nonnegative safe integer, in cents\\n * @param {number} count - positive safe integer, \\u003c= 1000\\n * @returns {number[]} count integer shares summing to total, differing by at most one;\\n *   the first (total % count) shares are one cent larger.\\n */\\nexport function splitCents(total, count) {\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total \\u003c 0) {\\n    throw new RangeError('total must be a nonnegative safe integer');\\n  }\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count \\u003c 1 || count \\u003e 1000) {\\n    throw new RangeError('count must be a positive safe integer \\u003c= 1000');\\n  }\\n  const base = total / count; // safe integer division result: exact integer or k + fraction\\n  const remainder = total - base * count; // total % count, exact for safe integers\\n  const shares = Array.from({length: count}, () =\\u003e Math.floor(base));\\n  for (let i = 0; i \\u003c remainder; i++) {\\n    shares[i] += 1;\\n  }\\n  return shares;\\n}\\n\"}"

            "file_path": "test/splitCents.test.mjs",
            "content": "import {test} from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {splitCents, protocolVersion} from '../src/shares.mjs';\n\ntest('protocolVersion is preserved', () => {\n  assert.equal(protocolVersion, 1);\n});\n\ntest('exact division', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(100, 4), [25, 25, 25, 25]);\n});\n\ntest('remainder goes to earliest indices', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(10, 3), [4, 3, 3]);\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(7, 4), [2, 2, 2, 1]);\n});\n\ntest('zero total', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(0, 5), [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);\n});\n\ntest('single share gets everything', () => {\n  assert.deepEqual(splitCents(12345, 1), [12345]);\n});\n\ntest('sum is preserved and max-min <= 1', () => {\n  for (const [total, count] of [[999999999999, 997], [1, 1000], [999, 999], [1000000, 1000]]) {\n    const shares = splitCents(total, count);\n    assert.equal(shares.length, count);\n    assert.ok(shares.every((s) => Number.isInteger(s)));\n    assert.equal(shares.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), total);\n    assert.ok(Math.max(...shares) - Math.min(...shares) <= 1);\n    const extra = total % count;\n    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n      assert.equal(shares[i] - shares[i + 1], i < extra ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid total', () => {\n  for (const total of [-1, 0.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '10', null, undefined]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(total, 2), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('rejects invalid count', () => {\n  for (const count of [0, -5, 1.5, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2, Infinity, NaN, '2', null, undefined, 1001]) {\n    assert.throws(() => splitCents(10, count), RangeError);\n  }\n});\n"
          },
